spawnPlan.briefing:
CRITICAL OBSERVABILITY CRISIS: The entire KPI measurement layer is broken. 40+ metrics return errors — HTTP 404 (endpoints missing), "TBD-populate-before-orchestrator-go-live" (placeholder commands never implemented), SQL permission denied, shell syntax errors in grep commands. We are flying blind — cannot measure revenue, engagement, or any product metric.

Three live KPIs reveal critical gaps:
1. cron_auth_token_set=0 → CRON_AUTH_TOKEN not set in Render env. This blocks ALL scheduled jobs including the queue consumer (explains why R-Q2-M-011 has been stuck 51 days). IMMEDIATE FIX: set CRON_AUTH_TOKEN env var in Render.
2. razorpay_live_active=0 → Razorpay payment integration not live. This is a P0 REVENUE BLOCKER — no bookings can be paid for. Investigate: are RAZORPAY_KEY_ID and RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET in env? Is the webhook endpoint configured? Is test mode vs live mode the issue?
3. uptime_monitors_active=4 → partial monitoring exists but incomplete.

Priority work for this cycle:
1. Set CRON_AUTH_TOKEN in Render env — unblocks queue consumer and all cron jobs
2. Implement missing metrics API endpoints (the 404s) — create /api/metrics/* routes that return real data from the database
3. Replace ALL "TBD-populate-before-orchestrator-go-live" placeholder commands with real shell commands that query the codebase/database
4. Fix SQL file permission issue (sql/cs/multilingual-macro-impact.sql: Permission denied)
5. Fix shell syntax errors in KPI check commands (grep with parentheses causing "Syntax error: ( unexpected" — need proper quoting/escaping)
6. Investigate and fix razorpay_live_active=0 — revenue is blocked

This is FOUNDATIONAL: without working metrics, no other team's work can be measured or validated. Every other roadmap item's success criteria depends on this layer working. Target: get at least 20 KPIs returning real values by end of cycle.

NOTE: Do NOT touch items blocked by founder activation gates (R-Q1-IT-003 U6, R-Q1-IT-005 U12, R-Q2-IT-001 U6). Work only on R-Q1-IT-001 and R-Q1-IT-004 which are not founder-blocked.

Advance organic acquisition content that does NOT require founder input. Multiple marketing KPIs are stale/broken — need to ship actual content to move them: pillar_pages_shipped, programmatic_pages_live, cluster_articles_shipped, gsc_verified, social_accounts_active.

Priority work:
1. PILLAR PAGES: Create comprehensive pillar pages for high-intent keywords:
   - "Online Puja Booking" (parent page linking to city/service variants)
   - "Temple Darshan Online" 
   - "Hindu Priest Services"
   - "NRI Puja Services" (critical for NRI revenue line)
   Each pillar page should be 2000+ words, include structured data (PageSchema), internal links to cluster articles, and clear CTAs to booking flow.

2. PROGRAMMATIC SEO: Build city × service programmatic pages. Template: "{service} in {city}" for top cities (Indore, Bhopal, Nagpur, Patna, Bhubaneswar per geo focus + Varanasi, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Hyderabad). Each page pulls temple/pandit data for that city, includes unique local content, schema markup, and booking CTA.

3. GSC VERIFICATION: Set up and verify Google Search Console for darshya.online (or relevant domain). Submit sitemap. This unblocks SEO performance tracking.

4. CONTENT CLUSTERS: Write 3-5 blog articles in the "deity of the day" cluster format — each article covers a specific deity, their significance, associated pujas, and links to booking. Tag with cluster metadata.

5. SOCIAL SETUP: Create/verify social media accounts (Twitter/X handle, Instagram, YouTube channel). Document handles in docs/marketing/social-accounts.md.

AVOID founder-blocked items: R-Q1-M-003 (U8), R-Q1-M-010 (U7), R-Q2-M-006 (U2), R-Q2-M-008 (U7), R-Q3-M-* (all blocked by U3/U4/U5), R-Q4-M-003 (blocked). Focus ONLY on what can ship without founder action.

All content must include proper meta tags, OG images, schema markup, and internal links to booking pages. This is revenue-impacting: organic search is the primary zero-CAC acquisition channel.

Advance supply pipeline work that does NOT require founder to make phone calls or send WhatsApp messages. Many sales items are blocked on founder action — AVOID these: R-Q1-SA-001 (founder must send WhatsApp to 5 priests), R-Q1-SA-006 (blocked), R-Q1-S-008 (founder must dial T1 gaushala prospects), R-Q1-S-013 (GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY missing), R-Q3-S-002 (recruitment/KYC of 25 humans), R-Q3-SA-001/003/004 (U6/U4 blocked).

Focus on PREPARATION work that enables founder to execute quickly when unblocked:

1. TEMPLE DATA ENRICHMENT: Build comprehensive temple database for target cities. For each temple: name, address, deity, contact info (if publicly available), photos, darshan timings, festival schedule. Cities in priority order: Varanasi, Bengaluru, Mumbai (verified_temples_count KPIs exist for these), then Delhi, Pune, Hyderabad, then Tier-2 (Indore, Bhopal, Nagpur, Patna, Bhubaneswar).

2. B2B LEAD RESEARCH: Identify and research corporate Diwali gifting prospects. Build list of: company name, HR/admin contact, estimated employee count, previous Diwali gifting history (if findable), suggested pitch angle. Target 50 prospects. Document in docs/supply/b2b-corporate-diwali-prospects.md.

3. SUPPLY PIPELINE DOCUMENTATION: Create structured handoff documents for:
   - Temple outreach kit (call script, email template, WhatsApp message template, LOI template)
   - Pandit onboarding checklist (KYC requirements, contract template reference, payment terms)
   - Gaushala partnership proposal template
   - Astrologer recruitment criteria

4. CHAIN TEMPLE RESEARCH: Research ISKCON, BAPS, Sringeri temple chains. For each: list of temples in target cities, organizational structure, decision-making process for partnerships, existing digital presence. Prepare briefing docs for founder to use in meetings.

5. PROSPECT LIST BUILDING: Build prioritized prospect lists with all available public information so founder can execute outreach in minutes rather than hours when unblocked.

This is high revenue-impact/hour because it removes the research bottleneck from founder's critical path. When founder unblocks, they can immediately execute with prepared materials.

Advance support infrastructure that does NOT require native speaker review (R-Q2-CS-003 is blocked on native-speaker review for ta/te/bn/mr + Wati Meta template approval — AVOID). Focus on English and Hindi content only.

Multiple CS KPIs are stale/broken — need to ship actual content: help_articles_published, cs_macros_count, cs_macros_documented, wa_support_active, founder_inbox_auto_ack_pct.

Priority work:
1. HELP CENTER ARTICLES: Publish comprehensive help articles for top support queries:
   - "How to book a puja online" (step-by-step with screenshots)
   - "Cancellation and refund policy" (clear terms, timeframes)
   - "How to communicate with your assigned priest"
   - "Payment methods accepted" (Razorpay, UPI, cards)
   - "What to expect during a puja ceremony"
   - "NRI puja services — how it works" (dedicated NRI support article)
   - "Troubleshooting common booking issues"
   Store in docs/support/help-articles/ with frontmatter for searchability.

2. CS MACROS: Document standardized response macros for common support scenarios:
   - Booking confirmation follow-up
   - Refund request handling
   - Priest rescheduling
   - Payment failure recovery
   - NRI timezone coordination
   - Festival booking surge responses
   Create macro library in docs/support/macros/ with trigger keywords, response template, and escalation criteria.

3. WHATSAPP SUPPORT SETUP: Design WhatsApp support workflow:
   - Auto-acknowledgment message template (English + Hindi)
   - Menu tree for common queries (booking status, refund, reschedule)
   - Escalation path to human agent
   - Business hours and response time SLAs
   Document in docs/support/whatsapp-support-workflow.md. Do NOT submit to Meta for template approval (that's blocked on R-Q2-CS-003).

4. SUPPORT TICKET ROUTING: Create routing rules for support tickets:
   - Category-based routing (booking, payment, priest, technical)
   - Priority escalation criteria
   - SLA targets per category
   Document in docs/support/ticket-routing-rules.md.

5. FAQ PAGE: Build comprehensive FAQ page content for the website. Group by category (Booking, Payment, Priests, NRI Services, Technical). Each Q&A should be concise, scannable, and link to relevant help article for detail.

This work improves CS efficiency (reduces per-ticket handle time) and reduces churn (faster resolution). English/Hindi covers ~60% of target user base. Multilingual expansion deferred until native speaker review unblocks.
